summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of AI Academy. Backend: 26/27 pytest tests passed (96.3%). Auth, curriculum (4 paths, 22 models), progress (XP, streak, idempotency), pricing, and Stripe checkout (returns real https://checkout.stripe.com URL with cs_test_ session_id) all work. Single failure: AI Tutor does NOT retain conversation context across requests when re-using session_id — Claude responds 'this is the first message you've sent me'. Frontend: landing page, onboarding flow (Get Started → goal selection → signup), home, paths tab, models tab with category chips, tutor chat (Aida via Claude Sonnet 4.5 responds correctly to single message), path detail, lesson card swipe, quiz answer, and post-lesson XP update on home (1 streak / 50 XP / 1 lesson) all verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844).

critical.issue: Session context NOT persisted across calls with same session_id. Second message returns 'this is the first message you've sent me' — emergentintegrations LlmChat is being re-instantiated each request without loading prior conversation. The server stores user/assistant messages in chats_col but never feeds them back into LlmChat. Need to either (a) configure LlmChat to load history from session_id, or (b) manually pass prior turns from chats_col before sending new UserMessage.

issues: Bottom tab items (Home, Paths, AI Tutor, Models, Profile) do not expose testID attributes — automation must rely on text content / URL navigation. Add testIDs like tab-home, tab-paths, tab-tutor, tab-models, tab-profile in (tabs)/_layout.tsx for robust testing.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning repeating: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. RN web emits this for components passing pointerEvents as a prop instead of inside style. Likely from a Pressable / TouchableOpacity / View consumer or a vector-icons font wrapper. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): /api/tutor/chat must preserve conversation history. Either pass prior messages to LlmChat or use the SDK's built-in history loader with session_id. See test_tutor_chat_context — response should reference 'remembered' number.
Add testIDs to bottom tabs in (tabs)/_layout.tsx (tab-home, tab-paths, tab-tutor, tab-models, tab-profile).
Investigate and silence the 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN-web warning (likely move pointerEvents into a style object).

rca_of_issue: Tutor context bug RCA: server.py:303-331 creates a NEW LlmChat(session_id=...) on every /api/tutor/chat call but never seeds it with prior user/assistant turns. emergentintegrations.LlmChat does not auto-load history just because a session_id is passed — it uses session_id as a label only. Repro: POST /api/tutor/chat {'message':'Remember 42'} → gives session_id S. POST again {'session_id': S, 'message':'What number?'} → Claude has no memory and admits it's the first message. Mitigation: before calling send_message, fetch prior turns from chats_col where {user_id, session_id}, sort by created_at, replay them via chat.send_message or by constructing chat history per the emergentintegrations API (e.g. pass list of messages to LlmChat or call send_message in sequence). Without this, the Tutor cannot have multi-turn conversations as advertised.
